Mansoor bin Mohammed honours the institutional and individual winners of the 14th Dubai Award for Sustainable Transport 2026, one of the initiatives of Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) aimed at advancing sustainable transport. The 14th edition attracted more than 750 applications, marking a 400% increase. Entries were received from 45 entities in nine countries, alongside 460 individual entries from 22 countries.

Mansoor bin Mohammed: I honoured the winners of the 14th Dubai Award for Sustainable Transport, organised annually by Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) to advance sustainable mobility, drive innovation, enhance safety and protect the environment.
